Of course, as a first prototype, this system is not perfect, and
there is a lot to be learnt from:
The main PCB could have been more noise tolerant
By separating the analog ground from the digital ground
By placing the analog components closer together
By having digital signals as far as possible from analog signals
By matching the impedance of high frequency traces
The main PCB could have been made smaller
